::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** [<i>c</i>. 1898]  
**Manuscript:** MS Princeton University, Parrish Collection
:::

My dear [Anna](people/person_195.qmd)
I am only just in time to catch the post and thank you very much for the photographs. The outside of the house is charming, and [Annie Moberly](people/person_1024.qmd) is venturing to ask if she might have one of them and of the group. She and [Miss Price](people/person_1209.qmd) came out exactly like and she is like half her sisters. She would like them unmounted. I shall be very glad to see you when you make another attempt on the garden side, but I shall be out on Friday week probably on the Thursday and on the Friday

Yours sincerely
C M Yonge

---

**Note:** Perhaps associated with the photograph by Bramston of CMY aged 75, illustrated in Coleridge, *Life*, facing p 280.
